document.comment: Generated by tools/conformance-report.py from a run of tools/run-qt4.sh; do not edit by hand.
document.p: Results of the W3C QT4 test suite (third_party/qt4tests, ) under sxml-qt4 run (), a release build, one process per test set. Passed counts passes and wrong errors (a wrong error code counts as a pass, catalog-schema.xsd); not run means not applicable to sxml or using an unsupported feature; run is test cases minus not run.

item.p: Code under test: commit e74d4ad475b6 of 2026-10-20
